title: Dynamic code compilation via Function constructor in javascript — review required
description: new Function() compiles a string into executable code in the global scope. When any part of that string is request-derived, the caller runs arbitrary JavaScript with the application’s privileges. The rule flags the constructor; the provenance of the string is a review decision.
remediation: Replace dynamic compilation with a fixed dispatch table, or parse the expression with a restricted, non-executing evaluator.
limitation: Lexical: matches the Function constructor on one line; dataflow to the argument is out of scope.

tests.line: # audit: const fn = new Function("return " + expression); present
